steps.question: Which player scored the most goals in the 2018 World Cup, excluding own goals?
steps.content:
It’s a tie. In 2018 (own goals excluded), the top scorers in the loaded matches were:
- Antoine Griezmann — 2
- Ivan Perisic — 2
- Mario Mandzukic — 2

Takeaway: Three players share the lead with 2 goals each in the knockout matches available here.

Data used: world_cup.world_cup.goals joined via world_cup.world_cup.matches → world_cup.world_cup.tournaments (year = 2018), and player names from world_cup.world_cup.players. Note: this fixture contains only quarter-final through final matches; results reflect that scope.
steps.sql:
SELECT p.full_name AS player, COUNT(*) AS goals
FROM world_cup.world_cup.goals g
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.matches m ON g.match_id = m.id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON m.tournament_id = t.id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.players p ON g.scorer_player_id = p.id
WHERE t.tournament_year = 2018
  AND g.goal_type <> 'own_goal'
GROUP BY p.full_name
ORDER BY goals DESC, p.full_name ASC;

steps.question: ¿Quién fue el máximo goleador del Mundial 2018?
steps.content:
En este conjunto de datos, el máximo goleador del Mundial 2018 (autogoles excluidos) fue un triple empate: Antoine Griezmann, Ivan Perisic y Mario Mandzukic, con 2 goles cada uno.

Detalle y alcance:
- Cálculo basado en world_cup.world_cup.goals unido a world_cup.world_cup.matches → world_cup.world_cup.tournaments (año 2018) y world_cup.world_cup.players.
- Nota de cobertura: este fixture solo contiene partidos desde cuartos de final en adelante (no incluye fase de grupos ni octavos), por lo que el resultado refleja únicamente esas etapas.
steps.sql:
SELECT p.full_name AS player, COUNT(*) AS goals
FROM world_cup.world_cup.goals g
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.matches m ON g.match_id = m.id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON m.tournament_id = t.id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.players p ON g.scorer_player_id = p.id
WHERE t.tournament_year = 2018
  AND g.goal_type <> 'own_goal'
GROUP BY p.full_name
ORDER BY goals DESC, p.full_name ASC;

steps.question: How many matches did Croatia win in the 2018 World Cup?
steps.content:
2

Notes
- Counted matches in 2018 where the recorded winner was Croatia (includes wins decided in extra time or on penalties).
- Scope reflects this fixture’s coverage: only knockout matches from the quarter-finals onward are loaded (no group stage or round of 16).

Data used: world_cup.world_cup.matches joined with world_cup.world_cup.tournaments and world_cup.world_cup.teams.
steps.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS croatia_wins_2018
FROM world_cup.world_cup.matches m
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON m.tournament_id = t.id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.teams w ON m.winner_team_id = w.id
WHERE t.tournament_year = 2018
  AND w.common_name = 'Croatia';

steps.question: ¿Cuántos partidos ganó Croacia en el Mundial 2018?
steps.content:
Croacia ganó 1 partido en el Mundial 2018 (en las fases cubiertas por este dataset: cuartos en adelante).

Detalle:
- Semifinal: Croatia 2–1 England — victoria (confirmado que hubo prórroga).
- Cuartos: Russia 2–2 Croatia; 3–4 en penaltis — se cuenta como empate según la regla de no computar tandas como victorias.
- Final: France 4–2 Croatia — derrota.

Nota metodológica: conté victorias solo cuando el equipo quedó por delante en goles tras 90’ o prórroga y excluí definiciones por penaltis. Este dataset solo incluye partidos desde cuartos de final en 2018. Fuentes: world_cup.world_cup.matches, world_cup.world_cup.tournaments y world_cup.world_cup.teams.
steps.sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT id FROM world_cup.world_cup.teams WHERE common_name ILIKE 'Croatia' LIMIT 1
)
SELECT m.stage, m.went_to_extra_time
FROM world_cup.world_cup.matches m
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t ON m.tournament_id = t.id
JOIN c ON TRUE
WHERE t.tournament_year = 2018
  AND (m.home_team_id = c.id OR m.away_team_id = c.id)
  AND m.home_penalties IS NULL AND m.away_penalties IS NULL
  AND (
    (m.home_team_id = c.id AND m.home_goals > m.away_goals)
    OR (m.away_team_id = c.id AND m.away_goals > m.home_goals)
  );
